# ConceptualNetworkEmbedding

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
The process of embedding conceptual graph structures into neuromorphic spiking neural networks for associative recall and pattern completion. Directly bridges symbolic linguistic knowledge with neuromorphic computing, enabling brain-inspired handling of idiomatic semantics.
